title: Flashcards: Reptiles, scientific names
intro: Flip each card about reptiles. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Black Iguana?
cards.explain: The Black Iguana is Ctenosaura similis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Western green mamba?
cards.explain: The Western green mamba is Dendroaspis viridis.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the leatherback sea turtle?
cards.explain: The leatherback sea turtle is Dermochelys coriacea.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Gila monster?
cards.explain: The Gila monster is Heloderma suspectum.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Rinkhals?
What is the scientific name of the Banded sea krait?
cards.explain: The Banded sea krait is Laticauda colubrina.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the carpet python?
cards.explain: The carpet python is Morelia spilota.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Egyptian cobra?
cards.explain: The Egyptian cobra is Naja haje.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the monocled cobra?
cards.explain: The monocled cobra is Naja kaouthia.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Caspian cobra?
cards.explain: The Caspian cobra is Naja oxiana.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Black softshell turtle?
cards.explain: The Black softshell turtle is Nilssonia nigricans.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Corn snake?
cards.explain: The Corn snake is Pantherophis guttatus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Blood Python?
cards.explain: The Blood Python is Python curtus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Ocellated lizard?
cards.explain: The Ocellated lizard is Timon lepidus.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Sand goanna?
cards.explain: The Sand goanna is Varanus gouldii.

cards.front: What is the scientific name of the Meadow Viper?
cards.explain: The Meadow Viper is Vipera ursinii.
